newsitem.title: FRANCE: New GAN head will name new CIC head - source.
newsitem.headline: New GAN head will name new CIC head - source.

text.p: The new head of state-owned insurer Groupe GAN will name a new president for GAN banking unit CIC, a source close to the subject said on Monday.

The government said earlier it was calling on GAN head Jean-Jacques Bonnaud to resign. Finance Mininster Jean Arthuis called off the privatisation of CIC last week and attacked the heads of both GAN and CIC for undermining the sale.
"The new chairman of GAN will name a new head of CIC," the source said.
The source declined to give any names for likely successors to Bonnaud as GAN head, but said this could be known by the end of the week.
CIC chairman Bernard Yoncourt infuriated Arthuis in October after declaring on television that the sale of CIC to a major French bank could spell the death of the regional banking network.
